code: export const API_BASE_URL=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL||"http://localhost:5000/api";export const API_ORIGIN=API_BASE_URL.replace(/\/api\/?$/,"");export async function apiRequest(path){let options=arguments.length>1&&arguments[1]!==undefined?arguments[1]:{};const token=localStorage.getItem("cegct_token");const response=await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}${path}`,{...options,headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json",...(token?{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}:{}),...options.headers}});const payload=await response.json().catch(()=>({}));if(!response.ok){throw new Error(payload.error||`Request failed (${response.status}).`);}return payload;}
